author: foodstops56332
quote:
I’ve been waiting since 2013, and my patience has aged worse than the original Vice City soundtrack. For that kind of wait, I expected to be personally tucked in by Rockstar staff.

First, the hype was never going to be matched. The trailers promised a living, breathing world. What I got was a living, breathing world where I still get stuck on a lamppost while a pedestrian calmly films me.

Second, the price. I paid full price plus whatever the “Ultra Mega Gold Criminal Edition” costs, and the first thing I noticed was how many other things I could buy. I’m now thinking of spending £70 on a very nice sandwich and a lie-down.

Third, the traffic. In a game about crime, I spent 40 minutes obeying a red light because my character wouldn’t stop. I’m a grown adult. I have a real commute for that.

Fourth, the map is too big. I got lost, I got hungry, and I realised I’d been in the same state for six hours doing nothing. That’s just my life.

Would not recommend to anyone who isn’t already planning to buy it anyway.

Verdict: 1/5. Still playing it right now.
